The collection contains raw and partially polished stones in colors such as blue, green, white, pink, and reddish brown. Specimens include crystalline clusters, hexagonal and prismatic formations, and rough matrix stones, suggesting quartz, calcite, aragonite, and more. Sizes vary, suitable for adding to an existing collection or starting a new one. They measure .5-2.5 inches each, due to the various hardness of each mineral scrapes, scuffs or flaking may happen.
